data.text: A Praise of David. א  Aleph I will exalt You, my God, O King, And I will bless Your name forever and ever.
ב  Beth Every day I will bless You, And I will praise Your name forever and ever.
ג  Gimel Great is Yahweh, and highly to be praised, And His greatness is unsearchable.
ד  Daleth One generation shall laud Your works to another, And shall declare Your mighty deeds.
ה  He On the glorious splendor of Your majesty And on the words of Your wondrous deeds, I will muse.
ו  Vav Men shall speak of the strength of Your fearsome acts, And I will recount Your greatness.
ז  Zayin They shall pour forth the memory of Your abundant goodness And will shout joyfully of Your righteousness.
ח  Heth Yahweh is gracious and compassionate; Slow to anger and great in lovingkindness.
ט  Teth Yahweh is good to all, And His compassions are over all His works.
י  Yodh All Your works, O Yahweh, shall give thanks to You, And Your holy ones shall bless You.
כ  Kaph They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom And talk of Your might;
ל  Lamedh To make known to the sons of men His mighty deeds And the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.
מ  Mem Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion endures from generation to every generation.
ס  Samekh Yahweh sustains all who fall And raises up all who are bowed down.
ע  Ayin The eyes of all wait on You, And You give them their food in due time.
פ  Pe You open Your hand And satisfy the desire of every living thing.
צ  Tsadhe Yahweh is righteous in all His ways And holy in all His works.
ק  Qoph Yahweh is near to all who call upon Him, To all who call upon Him in truth.
ר  Resh He will work out the desire of those who fear Him; He will hear their cry for help and He will save them.
שׁ  Shin Yahweh keeps all who love Him, But all the wicked He will destroy.
ת  Tav My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh, And all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever.
